name: Benin (ITS with ORTB levy, IRCM, IRF)

validation.referee: statute's own printed tables and amounts (Lean decide)
validation.notes: build phase: no referee values used; cases = Lean theorems (kernel instances and checks of the statute's printed tables and stated amounts, all proved)

sources: Code général des impôts 2023 (Loi n° 2021-15 du 23 décembre 2021, mise à jour LF 2023 loi n° 2022-33), Ministère de l'Economie et des Finances: https://finances.bj/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/63c7b8d3eef3c_Benin-CGI-2023-officiel.pdf
scale: 6000000 XOF (12 x 500 000 F, the threshold of the top (30 %) monthly ITS band)
unsupported: CNSS rate décret (Code de sécurité sociale 2003 art. 24 2)) not reached: rate from the CNSS page
registry_correction: BJ: ITS confirmed (CGI Loi 2021-15); no family relief; access B.
headline: Benin built from the 2023 official CGI (LF 2024-2025 not reached): monthly ITS 0-30 % on gross pay with no family relief at all, plus an ORTB levy of 1 000 F in March and 3 000 F in June that makes June pay of 60 001 F net 2 999 F less than 60 000 F.

w5_pattern_a.added: CNSS salarié 3,6 % of all remuneration (pension branch, no ceiling), reported, not deducted (ITS base is gross pay, CGI art. 122)
w5_pattern_a.provision: CNSS page "Procédure de recouvrement des cotisations" (cnss.bj, fetched 2026-11-20): "Pension : 10 % dont : 6.4 % à la charge de l'employeur 3.6 % à la charge du salarié", base "l'ensemble des rémunérations"; official secondary (rate décret under Code SS 2003 art. 24 2) not reached); CGI 2023 arts. 120, 122, 124
